comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 7dc3dab and doc/manual.md in the same tree. The stages knob runs 1 to 50 with a default of 8, and the fractional part crossfades one more stage, which is why it can be swept without clicking; the buffer holds 52 stages. The skew and modulation knobs have no parameter names from the maker, so the panel lettering is all there is. A 25 nanofarad capacitor value sets the allpass corner alongside the modelled resistance. Unlike the feedback module there is no output clipping here.
